answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 36026 Country: India Title: REGARDING USE OF SWEETS OF DIWALI. Question: My question is that if the sweets of diwali may be consumed yes or no for Muslim? Answer ID: 36026 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 129/129/M=1433) If the sweet is not offered in the name of god or goddess then it is allowable to eat it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
